# Nonlinear Diffusion and Entanglement — scientific retrieval map

Overview and principal results: README.md
Precise Hilbert-space model, resources and theorem contract: science/model.md
Connected proof route: science/README.md
Stochastic quadratic shear, Brownian Gram determinant, Gaussian mixture: science/conditional_gaussian.md
Sharp EB/PPT threshold, normalized Gaussian packet and Mehler integral: science/exact_threshold.md
Cubic upper/lower bounds with energy-unconstrained diamond norm: science/cubic_distance.md
One fixed finite-energy TMSV qualitative NPT survival: science/fixed_input.md
Gaussian kappa=0 comparison, weak-kappa upper and capacity cautions: science/interpretation.md
Primary-source attribution and internal project comparison: references/RELATED_WORK.md
Reproduction commands, checked cases and limits: verification/README.md

Critical distinctions:
- The full channel is non-Gaussian for kappa>0; only its conditioned paths are Gaussian.
- The exact threshold includes the eta>0 endpoint; NPT is proved separately below it.
- The kappa=0 Gaussian case is a distinct proof and can have a finite cutoff.
- The cubic rate is an all-input bound; exponent constants do not match, so do not assert a sharp coefficient.
- Fixed TMSV NPT does not imply useful memory, positive quantum capacity or finite-error recovery.
- The model and Mehler propagator belong to Speed–Lyu–Schubert. The Gaussian EB criterion belongs to Holevo/Riedel's framework.

A common 30-milestone map and one educational anchor will be integrated after source selection. Personal coaching contracts, learner attempts, answers and user-specific history are not repository material.
